source.text: Good morning. The library opens at eight thirty, and today's workshop begins just after nine. Please bring your notes, ask clear questions, and take your time.
source.instruct: A native English-speaking adult man with a neutral General American accent. His voice is clear, warm, composed, and articulate, with a natural medium-low pitch, conversational pacing, subtle expressiveness, and no theatrical or regional affectation. Studio-quality delivery.
